verdict.rationale: The pack only implies incremental adoption. Solid can author custom elements, embeds alongside native libraries through direct DOM access, and was used as a small embedded UI library in Asciinema. At the other end, it offers full-app features (SSR, stores, Context) and has been used on a largish web product for over a year. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mounting Solid into a portion of an existing page, a documented incremental-adoption or migration path (a community member notes there is no migration guide from React), and corroboration of scaling one codebase from widget to full app.
